# Privacy & Ethics

> Data privacy, security practices, and ethical AI policies.

Zencoder encrypts data in transit and at rest, minimizes data collection, and logically isolates customer workspaces. Enterprise controls include SSO/SCIM, role-based access, audit logging, and configurable retention.

For current security details, certifications, and policies, see the [Zencoder Trust Center](https://trust.zencoder.ai).

<AccordionGroup>
  <Accordion title="What measures does Zencoder take to ensure the privacy and security of my code?">
    All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. Customer workspaces are logically isolated. See the [Trust Center](https://trust.zencoder.ai) for certifications and detailed controls.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How does Zencoder address ethical concerns related to AI in coding?">
    Zencoder follows responsible AI practices. You can report concerns via the [AI Adverse Impact Reporting Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScPgka564_ZDc3c30fL17VFuyRQmwUb95rxpe9bGjlb3kFdOA/viewform).
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How does Zencoder protect my personal information?">
    Encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege internal access, and logical workspace isolation. Details at [trust.zencoder.ai](https://trust.zencoder.ai).
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="What are my rights regarding my personal information?">
    Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to:

    <ul>
      <li>Access your personal information.</li>
      <li>Correct inaccuracies in your personal information.</li>
      <li>Delete your personal information.</li>
      <li>Restrict the processing of your personal information.</li>
    </ul>
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="How can I report an adverse impact?">
    To report any concerns or incidents, please complete the [AI Adverse Impact Reporting Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScPgka564_ZDc3c30fL17VFuyRQmwUb95rxpe9bGjlb3kFdOA/viewform). This helps us assess, address, and respond to potential risks responsibly.
  </Accordion>

  <Accordion title="Where can I track Zencoder’s current security posture and certifications?">
    You can find up‑to‑date information on our security controls, certifications and attestations, data handling practices, and availability in the Zencoder Trust Center: [trust.zencoder.ai](https://trust.zencoder.ai). It centralizes policy summaries, security documentation, and status updates, helping teams quickly review our posture and request additional details when needed.
  </Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>
